slides.headline: Tesla Just Turned Cybercab Owners Into Passive Income Earners
slides.body: **Elon Musk** broke it down: one tap in the Tesla app, your Cybercab joins the fleet and earns while you're away. You pick the window, a few hours, a few days, or a full week. Want it back? One tap

slides.headline: While You Scrolled, Someone Had AI Build Them a Custom Game
slides.body: They described the game they wanted to **Astra**, Google's AI assistant, and were playing it within minutes. No code, no design files, just a description in plain words. The person called it 'obviously trivial,' but **12,399 people** liked it anyway

slides.headline: Claude's Build Tool Just Opened to All Paying Users
slides.body: **Claude's** build tool went live for **Plus and Business** tier users today. The team's full launch message was four words: 'Happy building'

slides.headline: A Private Rocket Just Hit Orbit on Its Second Attempt
slides.body: **Isar Aerospace's Spectrum** launched from Andøya Spaceport in Norway and reached orbit on attempt number two. That puts a privately built European rocket on the orbital map, launched from Norwegian soil

slides.headline: A $3 Item in 1913 Costs $100 Today
slides.body: The **US dollar** has lost **97%** of its purchasing power since the Federal Reserve launched in 1913. That's your money being worth three cents on the dollar, compounded quietly over a century

slides.headline: SAVE TODAY'S AI BRIEFING
slides.body:
• Tesla's Cybercab earns money while you're away, one tap, Airbnb-style
• Google's Astra builds any game you describe, within minutes
• Claude's build tool opened to all Plus and Business users
• Isar Aerospace's Spectrum hit orbit on its second attempt
• The US dollar is down 97% in purchasing power since 1913

caption:

Tesla's Cybercab explained as an Airbnb-style fleet where owners tap once to earn while they're away, Google's Astra building any game a user describes in plain words and having them playing within minutes, a major AI build tool going live for all Plus and Business subscribers, Isar Aerospace's Spectrum rocket reaching orbit on its second launch from Andøya Spaceport in Norway, the US dollar having lost 97% of its purchasing power since the Federal Reserve launched in 1913.
